evals.expected_output: The skill gathers commitments, reviews the past week, caps priorities at three, and produces a short plan with a first action per priority.
expectations: The user is asked for their commitments before any plan is produced.
No more than three priorities appear in the final plan.
Each priority has a concrete first action.

evals.prompt: Plan my week: my only input is that I have no meetings and no task list.
evals.expected_output: With almost no inputs, the skill still runs the review honestly rather than inventing commitments, and the plan reflects only what the user actually said.
expectations: No commitments or calendar events are invented.
The final plan is under one page.
